attackers_goals: Attackers want to maintain indirect control over the resource. Attackers intend to allow public access, making it harder to detect future activity. Attackers are constantly monitoring for public assets to steal sensitive information.
description: Azure Storage Account network permissions modified to public, exposing data to any network and unauthorized identities.
detector_tags: Cloud Data Asset Public Exposure, Data Detection & Response
investigative_actions: Check if the storage account should be accessed from all networks. Disable public network access if needed. Check if the identity performed additional malicious activity and restrict permissions for the identity if required.
name: Azure storage account was publicly shared
